required_external_authority: human/native review for generated user-facing text

method_rules: Evidence shelves come before translation or revision.
A term anchor is not a term approval.
FAIR-style mechanical validation and CARE/TRUST-style authority review answer different questions.
Open source means inspectable and forkable, not authorized, accepted, or safe by default.
For Interslavic/Panslavic work, Latin/Cyrillic sidecars are part of authority and accessibility.
For Romance bridge ideas, French and Spanish natural-language shelves remain separate from any Pan-Romance experiment.
For Persian-family work, fa_IR, prs_AF, and tg_Cyrl_TJ remain separate sublanes unless a cross-register rationale and review justify linking them.
For Arabic, mathematical register and educational register need native review.
For under-served educational contexts, the default posture is open-source handoff, not intervention.
